# The dictionary (ravnix.dictionary.file): the words every tool with a
# word list gets. ravnix-dict reads and writes it; a word added in any tool
# comes back here, and a word is removed only here.
#
# One entry per line: the word, then optional fields after " | ":
#   lang=   the languages it belongs to, as two-letter codes (lang=de,en)
#   heard=  what speech recognition wrote instead, separated by ";"
# Lines starting with # are comments.

Huginn | heard=Hugin;who gin
Muninn
CLAUDE.md
Open WebUI | lang=en
Übergrößenträger | lang=de
Straße
C#
self-hosted | lang=en | heard=self hosted
  indented   |   lang=de,en   |heard=in dented
Zettelkasten | lang=de | note=a field ravnix-dict does not know

# A block of its own, after a blank line.
Nix
nixpkgs
